vantage-frontier.title: Vantage Data Centers unveils Frontier, a $25B mega-campus in Texas (Aug 2025)
vantage-frontier.note: 1.4 GW, ten data centres on 1,200 acres in Shackelford County; first building second half of 2026. Customer not named in this release.

related-michigan.title: OpenAI, Oracle and Related Digital announce Stargate site in Michigan (30 Oct 2025)
related-michigan.note: Saline Township, 1+ GW, three buildings; operated by Related Digital and Oracle for OpenAI; construction early 2026.

vantage-wisconsin.title: OpenAI, Oracle and Vantage announce Stargate site in Wisconsin (22 Oct 2025)
vantage-wisconsin.note: Port Washington 'Lighthouse', four data centres, close to 1 GW, completion 2028.

stargate-sites-press.title: Coverage of OpenAI's 'five new Stargate sites' announcement (Sep 2025)
stargate-sites-press.note: OpenAI's page returned 403 to automated reading; the Shackelford and Dona Ana anchor attribution rests on secondary coverage (Vantage, Epoch AI, El Paso Matters).

jupiter-press.title: Albuquerque Journal: Dona Ana County's Project Jupiter joins Stargate (Sep 2025)
jupiter-press.note: Secondary. Developers BorderPlex Digital Assets and STACK Infrastructure; 18-year Oracle lease; estimated operational by end of 2026.

sites.name: Project Jupiter (Stargate)
sites.notes: 18-year lease to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. No MW figure found in a source reached here.

power.note: 'close to a gigawatt' — recorded as 1,000, slightly generous

provider_notes: Oracle is the first provider with both regions and AI build sites in one file: it sells cloud regions and also operates OpenAI's Stargate capacity.
Stargate Abilene is recorded once, under Crusoe (its developer), so it is not counted twice. Oracle operates it for OpenAI.
Milam County, TX and Lordstown, OH are Stargate sites developed by SoftBank, not Oracle, and are not recorded here.
Oracle publishes no fleet-wide power figure; its disclosures are in remaining performance obligations and capex, not megawatts.
